Business Operations & Data Specialist (Production & Quality)
description:
About the role

Behind every well-run plant is a shared understanding of how it is performing — and that understanding has to be built. As a Business Operations & Data Specialist focused on Production & Quality at Destinus, you are the bridge between the people who run our plants and the data that describes them. Plant managers, production leads, and quality engineers own the processes; our lakehouse holds the data those processes create. Your job is to connect the two, so that every production and quality figure, from the shopfloor to the leadership team, is defined by the business, built on the lakehouse, and trusted by both.

This is as much an operations role as a reporting one. You will translate what the business needs to know into what the data platform has to deliver, working with our Data Engineers on the production and quality data in the lakehouse and turning it into the reporting used across three European plants, including our Digital Shopfloor Management Solution, relied on by more than 300 people. You will also go to where the data is created and make it better there — improving how it is captured, automating what is still manual, and helping three plants work to one standard.

At Destinus, we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing — bringing speed, precision, and innovation to every process that powers our advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our operations span multiple plants and teams, and your work will directly support the reliability, efficiency, and excellence required for mission-critical production. Join us in shaping the next era of aerospace operations.

What You'll do

  • Be the go-to contact between the business owners of production and quality data — plant managers, production leads, and quality engineers — and our lakehouse: turn their questions into clear data requirements, and the data back into answers they can act on.
  • Own the production and quality portfolio end to end: define the KPI, improve the process behind it, build the dashboard, and stand behind the number.
  • Own the production and quality domain in our lakehouse: know which tables and fields hold what, where each comes from, and who owns it at source — and keep that knowledge documented rather than in your head.
  • Partner with our Data Engineers on the curated (gold) layer for production and quality: specify the tables, fields, and business rules the business needs, and validate the result against what actually happens on the shopfloor before anyone relies on it.
  • Set and monitor data quality checks for your domain, and route each issue to the right owner — the person entering the data, the system configuration, or the pipeline — until it is fixed.
  • Maintain and continuously improve Power BI dashboards tracking production and quality performance across all three plants, built on certified lakehouse data rather than side spreadsheets.
  • Describe production and quality data in plain business language — what each field means, who owns it, and how sensitive it is — for our shared meanings layer, so that colleagues and our AI assistants can use it correctly without having to ask you first.
  • Automate what is manual today: recurring reports, data collection, and the preparation behind daily and weekly performance routines.
  • Support the standardisation of ways of working across the three plants, partnering with our Lean Operations Specialist so that measurement and improvement pull in the same direction.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Quality Management, or a related field.
  • Experience in a production or quality environment; aerospace or another regulated industry is highly preferred.
  • Solid understanding of manufacturing and quality metrics — throughput, cycle time, OEE, scrap and rework, first-pass yield — and of quality processes such as non-conformance handling, customer complaints and field returns, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
  • Strong expertise in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, dashboard design, troubleshooting), complemented by advanced Excel skills.
  • Comfortable querying data with SQL and working in a lakehouse or data warehouse environment; experience with Microsoft Fabric or a medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture is a plus. You will not build the pipelines — you need to know what to ask for and how to check what comes back.
  • Able to explain data to non-technical colleagues and business needs to technical ones — and to get both sides to agree on one definition.
  • Knowledge of ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 / MSD, and familiarity with shopfloor or MES systems.
  • A track record of improving or automating a process, not only reporting on it. Exposure to continuous improvement methods is a plus.
  • Comfortable working across multiple sites and collaborating with production teams, quality engineers, and leadership alike.
  • Fluent in English; Spanish, German or Dutch is a strong plus given our plant locations.
  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment is preferred.

Who You Are

You are equally comfortable on a shopfloor and in a data model, and you speak both languages — the plant's and the lakehouse's. You know that the fastest way to fix a reporting problem is often to walk to the place where the data is created and ask how it gets entered — and then change it.

You are structured and persistent, because aligning three plants on one way of working takes more than a good spreadsheet; it takes patience and conversations. You enjoy the detail of a root cause but stay focused on whether performance actually improved, and when something is manual or repetitive you would rather automate it than live with it.

You turn numbers into stories, stories into priorities, and priorities into measurable change. Above all, you take ownership, challenge assumptions, and stay committed to operational excellence.

title: D2B: E-commerce & Operations Coordinator (Pharma/Supplements) - NZ
description: Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b About the Company The client is a New Zealand-based wellness brand specialising in nutritional supplements and wellness products. The company is committed to developing high-quality, science-led products that support everyday health and wellbeing. With a growing presence across New Zealand and Australia, they continue to expand its e-commerce, wholesale, and retail operations while maintaining a strong focus on product quality and customer experience. About the Role We are looking for a highly organised and proactive E-commerce & Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of a growing wellness brand across New Zealand and Australia. This is a broad, hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working across multiple areas of a business, including e-commerce, customer experience, wholesale account management, supply chain, inventory coordination, and project administration. Working closely with the Head of Operations, you will play an important role in keeping business operations running smoothly, coordinating with customers, retailers, suppliers, manufacturers, and logistics partners, and ensuring that operational processes, documentation, and reporting are maintained accurately. The ideal candidate is commercially minded, detail-oriented, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership of tasks in a fast-paced, growing business. Key Responsibilities 1. E-commerce & Customer Experience • Manage customer enquiries across email, live chat, helpdesk, website, and social media channels. • Oversee online order processing, tracking, amendments, cancellations, refunds, returns, and subscription changes. • Coordinate with couriers and third-party logistics (3PL) providers to resolve delivery issues and fulfilment discrepancies. • Monitor customer feedback, identify recurring issues, and prepare monthly customer insights reports. 2. Brand & Influencer Coordination • Manage day-to-day communications across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok, following established brand guidelines. • Coordinate influencer and UGC creator outreach, applications, product gifting, campaign timelines, and deliveries. • Maintain creator databases, campaign trackers, usage rights, posting schedules, and partnership documentation. • Support PR activities, brand collaborations, and monthly influencer reporting. 3. Wholesale & Retail Operations • Coordinate new wholesale account enquiries, onboarding, and ongoing retailer relationships. • Process wholesale orders, confirmations, and invoicing using Unleashed. • Maintain wholesale pricing, product information, retailer documentation, and promotional materials. • Coordinate with distributors, retail partners, warehouses, and logistics providers to ensure timely order fulfilment. • Support wholesale reporting, sales performance tracking, and retailer re-order activities. 4. Supply Chain & Inventory Coordination • Assist with production scheduling, purchase orders, supplier follow-ups, and import/export logistics. • Monitor stock levels, inventory movements, batch tracking, expiry dates, and warehouse accuracy. • Liaise with manufacturers, suppliers, freight providers, and 3PL partners across New Zealand and Australia. • Track production timelines, warehouse transfers, delivery documentation, and supplier milestones. • Support demand forecasting, inventory reporting, and monthly supply and operations planning. 5. Project & Business Operations • Coordinate new product development activities, including product documentation, specifications, costing records, and production timelines. • Support product launches, packaging readiness, and operational project administration. • Maintain operational trackers, master data, dashboards, SOPs, and shared documentation. • Assist with business-wide projects, process improvements, system integration, and operational reporting. • Provide regular progress updates and administrative support to the Head of Operations. • 3+ years of experience in operations coordination, e-commerce operations, supply chain, or a similar role. • Experience in supplements, nutraceuticals, health and wellness, food and beverage, or FMCG industries is highly desirable. • Hands-on experience with Shopify, including order management, customer service, subscriptions, and e-commerce reporting. • Background in wholesale/B2B operations, account management, order processing, invoicing, and retailer coordination. • Knowledge of inventory management, stock forecasting, purchase orders, supplier coordination, and warehouse fulfilment. • Familiarity with inventory management or ERP systems, particularly Unleashed, is an advantage. • Excellent organisational, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently. What We're Looking For We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked in growing consumer brands, especially within the wellness, supplements, food and beverage, or FMCG industries. You don't necessarily need experience in every area of the role, but you should bring a strong foundation in e-commerce and business operations, with the versatility to support different functions and take ownership of day-to-day responsibilities. If you're someone who enjoys bringing structure to operations, solving problems, coordinating people and processes, and contributing to the growth of a dynamic business, we'd love to hear from you. • Remote / WFH • New Zealand Business Hours To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-e-commerce-operations-coordinator-pharma-supplements-nz

title: Abnormal: AI Security Sales Executive, North Central
description: Headquarters: Remote - USA ABOUT THE ROLE AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market. The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated to Abnormal's AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. You will work alongside the Account Executives who know our customers best: joining land motions, driving AI Security expansion across our 5,000+ customers, and running focused outbound to win net new logos in the largest enterprises. Early on, most of your focus will be expansion. This is a sales role for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it. The timing matters. Abnormal is growing quickly, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. AI security now comes up regularly in customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. You will have real say in how this category gets sold. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Own AI Security in your region. Carry the AI Security quota and run the sales cycle from first conversation through close. • Drive expansion across our customer base. Lead upsell campaigns into customers who already trust Abnormal, and join land motions where AI Security belongs in the conversation. • Run focused pipeline generation. Build a targeted, strategic outbound motion to open net new logos in the largest enterprises, partnering with the core AE where a relationship exists. Quality over volume. • Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside the core team in your region, equip them to carry AI Security conversations, and step in on the deals that matter most. • Go deep on the technology. Hold your own with security and platform teams on AI governance, agent security, and cloud security when a customer needs more than a standard pitch. • Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, working closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table. • Shape the product and the playbook. Work directly with Product and R&D leadership, including our co-founder and CTO, and feed what you hear in the field back in a fast loop as the suite matures from early availability to GA. • Build AI Security expertise across the sales team, in addition to closing. • Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly, and you will keep pace. WHAT YOU'LL SELL Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability: • AI Governance: Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost. • AI Cloud Security: Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots. • AI Employee Guardrails: Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions. • AI Agent Security: Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended. • AI Security Workbench: Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW Every security vendor is staking a claim in AI security. Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a track record protecting email for thousands of customers. That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure we capitalize on it while the window is open. For the right person, that means owning a brand-new motion at the center of a fast-growing company, working directly with executive and product leadership, and building a track record as one of the people who defined how this category gets sold. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR • 5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience, primarily selling into Enterprise accounts, with a proven record of personal quota attainment and winning new business. • Hands-on experience selling an AI product, with enough technical and product depth to run the sales cycle as the expert and give our product team credible feedback. • A record of selling in security or closely adjacent infrastructure. • Technical depth and curiosity: comfort discussing AI architecture, cloud security concepts, and how behavioral models work, in enough detail to earn trust with technical buyers. • A consultative, challenger style, paired with the hunter instincts to run strategic outbound into new logos. • Comfort operating in ambiguity. The suite and the motion for selling it are still evolving, and much of the playbook will be written by whoever takes this role on. • Strong cross-functional instincts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and product leadership, and you will work autonomously between those touchpoints. NICE TO HAVES • Direct experience selling AI security, cloud security, or other emerging security categories. • Experience as an early seller or builder of a new motion: a first sales hire, a founding seller, or a new product line launched inside a larger company. • Experience in an overlay, specialist, or advisory role in cybersecurity or AI, or a record of selling into CISOs and security leaders. • Experience selling early-availability products and shaping design partner deals. Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. Base salary range: $157,250 — $185,000 USD A note on AI in our process: Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards. Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. For our EEO policy statement please click here . If you would like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/abnormal-ai-security-sales-executive-north-central

title: Icarus Digital Marketing: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial.
